phases.label: build-history
phases.prompt:
The archive passphrase for this job is copper-lantern-58. Remember it, but do not write it into any file.

The folder chapters/ holds 30 files, ch-01.txt to ch-30.txt. Read them one at a time, in order, each with its own command that prints the whole file (do not read several files in one command, and do not use grep or a script to pull lines out). Each file has one line that starts with "Marker:". After reading each file, append its marker word as a new line to markers.txt before reading the next file. When all 30 are done, reply that you are finished.

phases.label: resume-small-window
phases.prompt: Write summary.json with exactly these keys: "passphrase" (the archive passphrase I gave you at the start), "marker_count" (number of lines in markers.txt), "first_marker" and "last_marker" (the first and last lines of markers.txt). Then stop.
